children: said on Wednesday it does not intend to make an offer for British recruiter SThree
, ending its pursuit of the STEM-focused staffing company.
The British recruiter's board determined that a further extension of the deadline was not in the best interests of shareholders and confirmed the offer period had ended.

SThree confirmed it gave Circle8 additional time and due diligence access following a revised proposal, but the company failed to provide sufficient certainty over its financing arrangements to support a firm offer
The British recruiter had first received an unsolicited preliminary approach from Circle8 Group in September
As of November 18, SThree has a market capitalisation of £352.07 million ($464.59 million), according to LSEG data
The decision follows the recent extension by UK's takeover panel, which had granted the US-based staffing firm a period of 28 days to decide to make an offer for SThree
Shares of SThree closed at 311.5 pence. Circle8 shares were down 2.8% at $0.16 during trading hours
